chunks: As for what al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Layth al-Muradi, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, concerning tayammum:
He said: You strike the ground with your two palms twice, then shake them off, and wipe your face and your forearms with them.

key_terms.التَّيَمُّمِ: dry ablution performed in place of wudu (ablution) or ghusl (ritual bath)
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth or ground used for tayammum
key_terms.تَضْرِبُ: you strike or place the palms upon the earth

ai.seo_question: How should tayammum be performed according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding tayammum. It describes striking the earth twice with both palms, then dusting them off and wiping the face and forearms.
